answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it may transact, with reputation earned only from attested, completed work. A fresh identity starts at zero — like a lotus that must grow before it blooms — so a thousand fake accounts cost a thousand stakes and yield no trust. Fraud burns the stake and the history, while honest work climbs toward the summit of the fee tiers. No fable of free trust: every privilege is paid for in locked capital or proven labor, so cloning identities costs more than the gain it buys.
